name: Astral Worlds: Power of the Delev
source:
Embark on an epic RPG adventure in this new fantasy universe. Create your hero and shape their skills and attributes to suit your playstyle as you explore a world defined by moral choices and real consequences.
Meet dozens of characters and engage in sexual relationships. Enjoy moments of pleasure between adventures or build intense romantic bonds, with both women and men willing to share the joys of passion with you.
Customize your character’s physical and aesthetic traits: gender identity, body type, genitals, and skin tone. Create an avatar that reflects your preferences and experience media, dialogue, and scenes that adapt dynamically to your choices.
translation:
在这个全新的奇幻宇宙中踏上史诗般的角色扮演冒险之旅。当你探索一个由道德选择和真实后果定义的世界时，创造你的英雄并塑造他们的技能和属性以适应你的游戏风格。
认识数十个角色并发生性关系。享受冒险之间的快乐时刻或建立强烈的浪漫纽带，男女都愿意与你分享激情的喜悦。
定制角色的身体和审美特征：性别认同、体型、生殖器和肤色。创建一个反映你的偏好的化身，并体验动态适应你的选择的媒体、对话和场景。
